No operator page could be found, and no official page confirms these hours after the reported Aug 1-Sep 14, 2026 renovation. Add the source and a 'check before visiting' note.

conflicts: Open status could not be confirmed. Secondary sources (Korean press summaries and travel-agency notices found by search) report a renovation closure from 2026-08-01 to 2026-09-14 and re-opening after Sep 15. No official notice of the closure or re-opening could be found: the Consulate General in Shanghai board (overseas.mofa.go.kr/cn-shanghai-ko, m_541) failed with redirect loops and connection resets, and no Huangpu district notice turned up. Search results did show a consulate notice of a 2026-01-05 to 01-08 closure for internal repairs.
A non-official travel blog (trvlogue.com, '2026년판') lists weekend hours of 09:00-17:00 with no midday break. This differs from the official-platform split hours. It is unverified.
collector_unconfirmed: fees, reservation, closed_days, access, duration, payment and language are not on any official page reached; two lookups found nothing.

notes: I opened every cited URL with curl and judged only from visible page text, with HTML comments and scripts stripped. bmy.com.cn was intermittent (TLS resets, http 503) but loaded on retry.

The meet-in-shanghai pages run by the Shanghai Culture & Tourism Bureau show a header date (2025年4月17日 / October 21, 2025) that comes from a 'currentDate' widget, not a page-update date. Treat these pages as undated, carrying a '仅供参考' disclaimer.

KPG site: the 2026-08-01 to 09-14 renovation closure appears only in secondary sources. No official page confirming the closure or the current open status could be found. The guide should date its hours and tell travellers to check before visiting.

Oriental Pearl fees come from a 13-month-old official list. They are verified only with the source date kept in the text. c11 is corrected to show the half-price offer was a one-week 2025 festival promotion.
Oriental Pearl c8 (immersive plaza project) was a 2024 one-month event, and highlight 5 should be removed or rewritten in the past tense.

Terracotta Warriors: the Chinese and English official pages disagree on season boundaries. The guide page also contradicts itself: off-season hours are 08:30-16:30, yet the 17:00 ticket-check cutoff is stated for both sites year-round.
